about: Every capability the application must never lose. Each entry is exercised against the real shipped widget tree by test/contract/must_have_features_test.dart on every listed target. Entries are append-only: removing or weakening one requires the owner's explicit approval recorded in approved_removals.json (see docs/TESTING.md, 'Must-have feature contract').

features.title: Synchronized Google tasks are listed
A task can be created from the main screen
A task can be completed from its row
Task details open from the list
Smart views (Focus, Upcoming, Missed, Unscheduled, All) are one step away
Search is reachable from the main screen
Synchronization can be refreshed and stopped by hand
Settings change the theme
Local data recovery is reachable
About screen shows the application version
Donate / Support the project opens the sponsorship page
Account screen signs out and back in without losing local tasks
Switch account removes the local copy and returns to first connection
Auto-sync on startup setting controls the startup run
Sync activity lists every run with its result
Full account backup can be exported and restored
Collapse completed subtasks is a persistent setting
Haptics can be turned off and on
Export shows a preview and copies to the clipboard
Export offers Share on Android and Save on every platform
